hero.title: Every order arrives ready to cut.
hero.description: Bespoke and made-to-measure orders come with the measurements the customer approved, the set they used and how it was taken. Their contact details stay private; you talk in the order's chat.

needs.title: Orders can't be placed without what you need
needs.description: Every garment has a list of the measurements it needs. Customers can't order until they're all in, and rough estimates are flagged so you know what to confirm.
points: A list of needed measurements for each garment
Helpful extras shown when the customer has them

ask.title: Something look off? Ask the customer
ask.description: Send a question about any measurement from the order. The customer replies from their order, and their answer corrects the copy you work from.
points: The order's measurements update with the answer

production.title: Tick off each step as you go
production.description: Mark the cut, the sewing, the finishing and your quality check. Then send photos of the finished piece; the customer approves them and pays the balance before you ship.
points: The customer sees progress without asking
Balance paid before it leaves your workshop

quote.title: Quote with the whole brief in front of you
quote.description: Quote requests arrive with the design, front and back, the styles and the customer's measurements. Price your work, set your days, and the fabric is priced from its listing.
points: The customer pays a deposit when they accept

conversion.title: Make it right the first time.
conversion.description: Join the vendor waitlist and get orders that arrive with everything you need to cut.

image.alt: High tech tailoring and measurement visualization
